context.body: The bounded canonical source is Exodus 32:1–14; its local speaker, audience, sequence, and literary form remain controlling evidence.

observations.body: The people demand gods, Aaron makes a calf, and the celebration names it as the one that brought Israel from Egypt.
observations.label: Israel makes a calf while Moses is on the mountain: action

observations.body: God speaks of destruction, while Moses appeals to deliverance, reputation, and ancestral promise.
observations.label: Israel makes a calf while Moses is on the mountain: response

payload.posture: Read Exodus 32:1–14 as covenant at the mountain evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: Israel’s rescue story is reassigned to an image, and the narrative says the LORD relents after Moses’ appeal without supplying a complete mechanism.
payload.title: Israel makes a calf while Moses is on the mountain
